author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Added a status banner above the tabs: 'N LinkedIn posts due this week' and 'N upcoming conferences (next 30 days)', each clickable to jump straight to that tab. Muted/gray when there's nothing to flag, colored when there's something to act on. Built generically (StatusBanner component, a plain items[] list) so more callouts can be added later without restructuring.
